summary.name: Tech to School
summary.one_liner: Tech to School is a K-12 technology vendor selling Chromebooks, iPads, Macs and PCs, with deployment, repair, warranty and a free device-tracking portal called Clara.
use_cases: buying Chromebooks, iPads or Macs for a school
tracking school device orders and repairs
enrolling and asset-tagging new school devices
managing warranty coverage across a school fleet
trading in old school devices for budget recovery
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Tech to School as a reseller of Chromebooks, Apple iPads, Macs and PCs for K-12 schools at contract pricing. Services listed include White Glove enrollment, setup and asset tagging, deployment, and repair including Warranty+ ADP and in-house authorized repairs. Clara is a portal for tracking orders, devices, repairs (RMAs) and warranty status, and it connects to Google, Apple and Intune. The company says it has served over 3,500 K-12 schools since 2003 and started as an Apple repair provider.
notable: Clara portal is free for every Tech to School customer and connects Google, Apple and Intune
Warranty+ ADP and in-house authorized repairs
White Glove enrollment, setup and asset tagging
caveats: Clara is only described as free for Tech to School customers, not for others
Device purchasing is at K-12 contract pricing, so it is aimed at schools rather than individual buyers
Specific prices and product lineup details are not given on the page
